lines.japanese: 「さァ、それはねーだろ」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. That's not fair.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、ロマンス全否定」
lines.english: “Oh? A complete rejection of romance.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ。男は常にロマンチストで、いつだって心に薔薇を敷きつめてんだよ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? A man is always a romantic. His heart is forever carpeted with roses.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、薔薇とかどうでもいいから。じゃなくて、だってクレープ屋だろ。そうそう長居する店でもねーし、そうそうカチ合うこたァねンじゃね？」
lines.english: “Forget the roses. That's not the point. It's a crêpe shop, right? Nobody stays there long. What are the odds we'd happen to run into each other?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、えっと、ドラさんは普段だいたい何時ごろパルクレープにいらっしゃるんですか」
lines.english: “Hmm. Um, what time are you usually at Paru Crêpes, Dra?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、夜？」
lines.english: “I don't know. At night?”

lines.japanese: 俺は適当に言った。パルクレープ勤務でもないのに、そんなの決まってるわけがない。
lines.english: I tossed out the first answer that came to mind. It was not as though I worked at Paru Crêpes; naturally I had no fixed hours.

lines.japanese: 「夜ならいらっしゃるんですかー？」
lines.english: “So you'll be there at night?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、いらっしゃるかもしンねーし、いらっしゃらないかもしンねーし」
lines.english: “Maybe I will. Maybe I won't.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶー、やっぱり依然ロマンス否定派ー」
lines.english: “Boo. Still firmly in the anti-romance camp.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって、キホン俺がいる時間とおまえのいる時間、そうそう交わらねーだろ。こっちプーで、おまえ学生。な？　これが実際問題。これがリアル」
lines.english: Look, our schedules basically never overlap. I'm unemployed, you're a student. Right? That's the practical problem. That's reality.

lines.japanese: 「はー、なるほどー。でも確率としてはゼロじゃないですよねー？」
lines.english: “Ah, I see. But the probability isn't zero, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「確率とかじゃねンだよ、いまはリアルの話をしてンだよ」
lines.english: This isn't about probabilities. I'm talking about reality here.

lines.japanese: 「ほー、たとえば今宵こうして出会ってしまったリアル？」
lines.english: “Oh? For example, the reality that we happened to meet tonight?”

lines.japanese: 「違げーよ、こんなのはただの偶然だよ。たまたまの一致だ」
lines.english: “No, this was just a coincidence. Pure chance.”

lines.japanese: 「偶然とかじゃないんですよ、いまはリアルの話をしてるんですよ」
lines.english: “This isn't about coincidence. We're discussing reality.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、たとえば今後一切カチ合わないリアル？」
lines.english: “Oh? For example, the reality that we'll never run into each other again?”

lines.japanese: 「違げーますよ、そんなのはただの予測です。いまはロマンスの話をしてるんです」
lines.english: “No. That's only a prediction. We're discussing romance.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　だから言ってんだろ。俺はいつだって心に薔薇を敷きつめてんだよ。金のハープを奏でているんだよ。てめ、俺のロマンスに文句あんのかブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “What? I already told you: my heart is forever carpeted with roses. I am forever playing a golden harp. You got a problem with my romance? I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あー分かりました、それではですね、中間を取ってリアルでロマンスをするということでひとつ」
lines.english: “Ah, I understand. Then let's split the difference and have our romance in reality.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、やっ、いや！　あの、いまのはですね！　あの、とくに意味深な発言というわけではなく」
lines.english: “Ah—no! Wait! What I meant was... That wasn't intended as a particularly suggestive remark...”

lines.japanese: 「わーってるっつの。いちいち照れんな」
lines.english: “I know. Quit blushing over every little thing.”

lines.japanese: 「フフ、でもちょっとドキッとしたな？」
lines.english: “Hee hee. But your heart skipped a little, didn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせーよ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「たはは」
lines.english: “Ta ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「も、行け。わーったからもう行け。電車、座れなくなんぞ」
lines.english: Just go already. I get it, so go. You're not gonna get a seat.

lines.japanese: 「はい。それではまたお会いしましょー」
lines.english: “All right. See you agaaain.”
